title: Fishery
summary: FISH'ERY, noun 1. The business of catching fish. 2. A place for catching fish with nets or hooks, as the banks of Newfoundland, the coast of England or Scotland, or on the banks of rivers.

inlines.v: FISH'ERY, noun 1. The business of catching fish. 2. A place for catching fish with nets or hooks, as the banks of Newfoundland, the coast of England or Scotland, or on the banks of rivers.
